change_summary: Tightened LLM archive backlog classification so earnings-snapshot-only candidate days are separated from real context-only recovery opportunities.
hypothesis: LLM soft ranking remains blocked by misleading replay backlog recoverability; candidate days with only earnings snapshots should not be counted as real context-only recovery opportunities.
notes: Primary replay window 2025-10-23..2026-04-21 kept identical trading metrics. Backlog fidelity tightened: missing candidate days stayed 26, but 24 are now classified as snapshot_only (earnings snapshot only), 2 as context_only, 1 prompt_ineligible, 0 prompt_ready. This blocks repeating raw-response/prompt recovery work on dates that never had meaningful LLM context.

locked_variables: LLM backlog recovery-tier classification for snapshot-only candidate days
